{{Quests and Events|Huanliu}}
==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(After {{Quest|Beyond the Shore's End}})
:'''Jiuri:''' Confirm with the Eye of Asteria if the Reverberation samples from the New Federation have been compiled.
:'''Jiuri:''' The Stellar Navigator team is ready. Prepare to simulate Lament-stricken areas on the Sand Table.
:'''Schubert:''' Reverberation data received. Searching for logic units within Tethys for Sand Table simulation.
:'''Schubert:''' Sand Table coordinates confirmed. Proceed to detect bad sectors... Negative. Simulation commencing.
:'''Huanliu:''' Reverberation data loaded. Simulating pre-Lament conditions.
:'''Huanliu:''' Given that the Waveworn occurred decades ago, Reverberations in this area are severely depleted, affecting simulation accuracy. 
:'''Huanliu:''' Success rate: 60%. Jiuri, please request additional computing power from the Matrices.
:'''Jiuri:''' Understood.
{{Dialogue End}}
